description: This PHP source file defines the BraketClient class in the Aws\Braket namespace. It extends the AwsClient class and provides method signatures for interacting with the AWS Braket service, including operations like creating, canceling, and retrieving quantum jobs and tasks, as well as tagging resources.

classes.name: BraketClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the AWS Braket quantum computing service, providing methods for managing quantum jobs, tasks, and resources.

methods.name: createJobAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new quantum job.

methods.name: createQuantumTaskAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new quantum task.

methods.name: getDevice
methods.description: Retrieves information about a quantum device.

methods.name: getJob
methods.description: Retrieves details of a quantum job.

methods.name: getQuantumTask
methods.description: Retrieves details of a quantum task.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags for a specified resource.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists tags for a resource.

methods.name: tagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously adds tags to a resource.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes tags from a resource.
